contentText: Every year on the third Thursday of November, France raises a glass to one of its most joyful traditions: Le Beaujolais Nouveau! That means that this Thursday, millions of bottles of the 2026 young red wine will be uncorked around the world, from Lyon to New York. Olivier Badoureaux, wine expert and director of the French trade organisation Inter Beaujolais, tells us what we should expect from this year's vintage.
